verdict.rationale: 1Password stores one-time-password tokens inside the vault (docs-20), and they are reachable from other devices such as Apple Watch and the mobile apps (docs-24, comm-9). That implies tokens follow the account to a new phone, but the pack never documents a new-phone migration flow. The import, export and Credential Exchange material covers moving data between apps, not between devices. Missing for 10: a documented guided new-device setup that brings over all OTP tokens, explicit confirmation that vault sync carries OTP seeds to a new phone, and hands-on corroboration of the migration.
